title: AI Model with 3B Downloads Embeds China Friendly Censorship

tickers.name: Airbnb, Inc. Class A Common Stock

summary:
Airbnb and Uber are among the American companies utilizing an artificial intelligence tool that restricts specific content and promotes political narratives. New research reveals the software incorporates biases favoring the Chinese government and is specifically programmed to censor users on certain topics.

The model has been downloaded more than 3 billion times globally, according to CBS News. These findings indicate that pro-Beijing viewpoints are embedded into AI systems that are deeply integrated into the operations of major US corporations.
